review_scope: Read worker/harness/wire, activation and generated numerical/IPC tests. Independently verify all seven current source files equal immutable snapshots and receipt hashes. Root separately reviews runner/phase gates and the full95-dependency closure before actual launch.
source_closure: The evaluated Up callback owns detached F32 inputs and I32 IDs; metadata ask callbacks do not capture or mutate payloads.

Down requires the matching context/run/arm/subrun/decode/layer epoch and exact IDs/geometry. Zero pilot masks still round-trip and consume once. Weighted/out closure is checked before each decode call returns.

Reply headers, slot membership, duplicates, dimensions, length and finite values are validated before the first graph write. Only complete pilot output rows are scattered using true tensor strides; unselected slots and padding are preserved.

Canonical/local/factor replacements remain unweighted expert outputs in the original slots. The original live-alpha MUL and native reduction order are retained, and each subrun allocates fresh KV/context.

Registry/source hashes gate payload loading. Per-layer preprocessing paths are explicit, and their files are checked against approved payload-manifest hashes; a future refreshed registry can bind new preprocessing without silently loading old geometry.

Canonical full-H input A8, exact integer dots, F32 scale order, pinned full-I activation and Down match the reused reference functions. Host factor latents remain floating point; no extra A8 is imposed.

Caller-only BLAS1 is separately limited/read back; strict checks include the actual caller through the guarded execution path. GGML, FMA/OpenMP and the separate activation process check their actual eight workers and MXCSR/x87 requirements.

Generated synthetic receipts cover full-H/I1408/I1024 canonical reference/B1/batch/framing equality, local/PE/G interfaces, owned snapshots, noncontiguous slot writes, zero masks, stale epochs, worker faults and target-logit indices. Reviewer inspected receipts, did not execute the tests.
approval_limits: TOOLING only: each model's first fixed FIT context, raw native128-token prefix and at most32 EOG-stopped greedy tokens for source/nohook, observer, original-copy, repeat, canonical and canonical-copy bit controls.
Canonical-copy is a repeat/copy control; the independent numerical evidence is the generated pinned-reference/B1/batch/IPC checks, not the copy arm alone.
This approves no DEVELOPMENT, PG acquisition, refresh collection/fitting, natural quality, bootstrap or TEST execution. The observer extension is currently a no-op and is not a refresh collector.
Current aggregate pilot-hit/trace diagnostics are tooling evidence, not complete per-operator refreshed deployment coverage or compression-cost measurements.

Original graph computation plus IPC/override work is quality-harness overhead, not compressed latency or8GB residency evidence. Numerical/tooling failures are invalid attempts, not scientific failures.
